name: Vorrat
tagline: Know if your household is ready for a crisis, and stay ready.
description: Vorrat (German for "supplies") is a private, self-hosted app for household emergency preparedness. It tracks real stock batch by batch with expiry dates, plans supplies for N people over D days from official civil-protection advice, and runs offline on a small machine such as a Raspberry Pi. The interface is a calm instrument panel: server-rendered, system fonts, one stylesheet, WCAG 2.2 AA.

logo.notes: Measured from vorrat/static/icon-*.png (the PWA and apple-touch icons). A paper-white storage jar with a blank label on a rounded forest-green tile (#2f6f4f). The jar is #f4f3ef, which matches the manifest background_color. There is no separate wordmark: the desktop sidebar sets the icon at 32px with the name "Vorrat" in system bold (750) at 1.25rem beside it. Keep the tile intact, never recolor it, and give it clear space of at least a quarter of its width. No vector source exists in the repo, so use the 512px PNG for large sizes.

colors.name: Paper
colors.usage: Page background (--bg). A warm, very low-chroma off-white that keeps the calm state quiet. Also the sticky header and the row hover fill. Measured from static/app.css :root. Dark: #121311.

colors.name: Card
colors.usage: Cards, lists, inputs and the navigation bar (--surface). White surfaces with a 1px border and no shadow. Dark: #1c1d1b.

colors.name: Ink
colors.usage: Body text and headings (--ink). 15.5:1 on Paper, 17.0:1 on Card. Dark: #ecebe7.

colors.name: Ink 2
colors.usage: Secondary text, section headings, metadata, inactive tabs (--ink-2). 6.4:1 on Paper, 7.1:1 on Card. Dark: #a8a49c.

colors.name: Line
colors.usage: Decorative dividers and card edges only (--line). Never the only edge of a control; fields use Field. Control edges use Field #8c877e (dark #77736b, 3.6:1); progress tracks use #d6d2ca (dark #3a3b38). Dark: #2c2d2a.

colors.name: Forest
colors.usage: Primary buttons, links, current tab, the covered state, progress fill (--accent). 6.0:1 on Card. Matches the icon tile and theme-color. Use only where action is needed; the calm state stays uncolored. Text on Forest is #ffffff; the soft fill for secondary buttons and notices is Forest Soft #e8f1ec (Forest on it 5.2:1). Dark: accent #6cc095 with ink #0d1a13 and soft #1d2b23.

colors.name: Focus Blue
colors.usage: The 3px :focus-visible ring and information notes (--focus). 6.4:1 on Card. Not for buttons or decoration. Dark: #8ab4ff.

display.notes: Measured. Vorrat ships no web fonts by rule (offline, no CDNs, Raspberry Pi). Headings use the platform UI face: SF on Apple, Segoe UI on Windows, Roboto on Android. Page title 1.25rem (1.5rem on desktop) at 600–700; the readiness number is 2.25rem at 750 with line-height 1.1. Section headings (h2) are 0.75rem, uppercase, letter-spacing .06em, in Ink 2.

body.notes: Measured: body is 1rem/1.45. The real stack order in app.css is -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif. Small text 0.875rem; nothing below 0.75rem, and 0.75rem only for tab labels. Inputs are 16px so iOS does not zoom. Labels and buttons 600–650.

mono.notes: Inferred: app.css only sets code at .9em with the browser default monospace. Use for barcodes and codes only.

voice.tone: A calm instrument panel, not an app that wants attention. Short, full sentences in active voice, no jargon, no exclamation marks. It informs and never frightens: no sirens, countdowns or red banners. It says what is true and what to do next, in words people read on a bad day, tired and one-handed. Numbers always carry units and "of" ("9 of 56 L", "3 of 14 days"); dates are human ("3 days ago", "12 Mar 2027"). Errors say what to fix, not what broke inside ("Enter a number, like 1.5.").
messagingPillars: Emergency plan first: targets come from official civil-protection advice (BBK) and adapt to household size and days.
Tracks real stock: batch by batch with expiry dates; use-up takes the batch that expires first.
Private by design: one binary, one SQLite file on your own machine. No account, no telemetry, no cloud.
Small and offline: runs on a Raspberry Pi, works without internet and without JavaScript.
Earned engagement: useful every day (expiry, shopping), never streaks, badges or nagging.

use: Ready for N of D days
avoid: jargon such as SKU or inventory unit

imagery.style: Functional, not decorative: user photos of their own products and documents, small inline SVG line icons, and native progress bars.
subjects: the household's own product photos (thumbnails from a barcode lookup or a phone upload)
scanned documents such as a passport or insurance
2px-stroke line icons: home, stock grid, plus, shield-check, cart, medical case, people, location pin, gear
imagery.treatment: Product thumbnails are 42px squares (64–88px on forms and item pages) with a 10px radius, object-fit cover and a Forest Soft placeholder that shows the initial letter. Icons are inline SVG, 24×24 viewBox, stroke currentColor, stroke-width 2 (2.5 for status icons), round caps and joins, no fills. The camera scanner is the only dark surface: black with a white 3px frame.
avoid: alarm imagery such as sirens or warning tape

layout.radius: 14px cards, 10px buttons and fields, 999px pills and chips, 6px checkboxes
layout.borderWeight: 1px (Line on cards, Field on controls); 2px tick boxes; 3px focus ring
postureRules: Every screen answers, in order: Are we all right? What needs doing? How do I do it? The most important number is first and biggest.

Phone-first, one column at most 720px wide with 16px gutters and a fixed five-place bottom navigation (Home, Stock, Add, Plan, Shopping), with Add as a raised round 48px button in the middle. From 64em a 248px sidebar replaces it (Add stock as the one primary button; current item = Forest Soft fill, Forest text, 4px left bar); from 75em pages use .cols at 3:2.
Flat surfaces: white cards with a 1px Line border and 14px radius on Paper, no shadows. Depth comes from the border, not elevation.
Every tap target is at least 44px tall (40px for small buttons and chips, rows 56px). One primary button per group; secondary actions are Forest Soft #e8f1ec with Forest text.

Status palette (measured; part of the brand palette even though outside the seven core roles): Amber #8a5a00 on Amber Soft #fff3d6 for soon, low and partly covered (dark #ffcc66 on #352a14); Brick #b3261e on Brick Soft #fbe9e7 for expired, missing and destructive (dark #ff8a80 on #3a1d1b); Slate #2f4f6f with white text for demo and offline notes.
Colour means 'look here': the calm state is uncolored. Status always pairs a colour with an icon and a word: check = Covered, clock = Soon/Low, exclamation in a circle = Expired/Missing.

Components: .btn (Forest Soft, 10px radius, 44px, weight 650; .primary Forest/white; .danger Brick Soft/Brick); field = visible 0.875rem label above a 44px input with a 1px Field border and 16px text; .chip = 40px pill, selected Forest fill; .pill = 0.875rem bold 999px status tag; progress = 10px rounded bar on Track, numbers always beside it; .notice = Forest Soft with 1px Forest border, role=status, optional Undo.

Type scale: readiness number 2.25rem/750/line-height 1.1 with its unit in 1.25rem Ink 2; page title 1.25rem (1.5rem desktop); section labels 0.75rem uppercase +.06em in Ink 2; body 1rem/1.45; small 0.875rem; nothing below 0.75rem.

States: hover underlines links, darkens buttons 3%, fills rows with Paper; never fade text to grey. Focus is a 3px Focus Blue outline at 2px offset, never removed. Current item uses aria-current plus a non-colour cue.
No motion: nothing animates, fades or moves on its own. Notices stay until the next page so Undo can't vanish. Honour prefers-reduced-motion and forced-colors by keeping borders.
Secondary information (files, barcodes, prices, history) lives in native <details> disclosures so the first screen shows only daily essentials.
Don't: web fonts or Inter, shadows, gradients, animation, fading toasts, red full-screen banners, several solid buttons for one action, inline styles, emoji icons, exclamation marks.
